text: First Data processor code 903 (Invalid or expired expiry date) corresponds to Visa response code 54 (Expired card). Diagnose it as expired card and follow the guidance for that code: update credential.

title: First Data processor code 904: Card not active
text: First Data processor code 904 (Card not active) corresponds to Visa response code 78 (Account not activated). Diagnose it as invalid account and follow the guidance for that code: contact issuer.

title: Visa reattempt limit
text: Visa limits how often a merchant may retry a declined card. Under the Visa Rules, a merchant may make at most 20 authorization attempts on the same card in 30 days for declines in categories 2, 3 and 4 (issuer cannot approve now, data quality, generic). Once a card has 20 attempts in the last 30 days, stop retrying, because further attempts incur fees. Category 1 declines (issuer will never approve) must never be retried.

title: Advice codes override response codes
text: A Mastercard merchant advice code or Visa decline category, when present, takes priority over the response code's usual guidance. For example, insufficient funds normally allows a later retry, but with Mastercard advice code 03 the merchant must not retry.

title: Mastercard 65 depends on region
text: Mastercard response code 65 signals that strong customer authentication is required for payments in Europe under PSD2; outside Europe it usually means an activity count limit was exceeded and a later retry may succeed.

title: Never expose raw decline reasons to cardholders
text: Processors such as Adyen instruct merchants not to show raw decline responses to shoppers, because detailed reasons can help fraudsters. Give the cardholder a general message and keep the specific reason for the merchant and support team.

title: Soft and hard declines
text: A soft decline is temporary, such as insufficient funds or an issuer timeout, and may succeed on a later retry. A hard decline, such as a lost, stolen or closed card, will not succeed on retry; the merchant needs a new payment method or updated card details.

title: Cards that cannot support recurring billing
text: Non-reloadable prepaid cards and single-use virtual card numbers cannot be charged again for subscriptions. Ask the customer for a different payment method.
